satellites.title: Wind in the Trigrams
satellites.evidence: The 說卦 commentary associates the trigram 巽 with wind. It is a traditional correspondence, not a claim about weather prediction.
satellites.caveat: A correspondence internal to a historical system; not a statement about natural science.

satellites.title: Wind in the Four Great Elements
satellites.evidence: In Buddhist lists of the four great elements, 地水火風 includes 風, corresponding to the Sanskrit vāyu. This scheme is distinct from the Yijing trigrams and the five phases.
satellites.caveat: A proposed equivalence awaiting verification in an aligned Sanskrit–Chinese source; citation assignment is not verification.
